cpu: AMD Ryzen 7 6800HS Creator Edition, Linux desktop
procedure: Compile identical allocation-counting harnesses against snapshots of speech_text before and after this change, reusing the same segment-parser and segment-rules libraries. Warm each case 20 times, then normalize 1000 times.
build: Normalization harness and speech_text compiled with rustc -C opt-level=3; reused Cargo dev-profile parser dependencies.

measurement.allocation_calls: Mean Rust global allocator alloc, alloc_zeroed and realloc calls per normalization, including the parser
measurement.allocated_bytes: Mean cumulative bytes requested from those allocator calls per normalization; not retained or peak memory
measurement.wall_us: Mean elapsed wall microseconds per normalization including allocator instrumentation

limitations: Timings were not isolated from other desktop activity and varied; they do not establish a CPU speedup.
Rust allocator counters exclude native inference.
